info.name: Extra Requirements Demo
info.description:
A short, linear walk through the extra requirements, for a demo video. Send the requests from top to bottom, or run the collection with the Collection Runner. Use the "Co-working Space Reservation - Local" environment for {{URL}}.

Run `npm run demo:reset` before each run. The reset deletes the users named Demo Admin, Demo Alice and Demo Bob, and the demo space, so "0. Setup" can register them again.

Each request name starts with a 4-digit number in the run order. Most names then give the actor: Admin, Alice or Bob. A name with no actor is a public request. The collection keeps one token for each actor, so you never log in or log out between requests.

To show the emails in real inboxes, set the collection variables adminEmail, aliceEmail and bobEmail to real addresses. The server must have SMTP_HOST set to send the emails. Without it, the server console shows each email.

"1.1" makes a reservation that ends a few seconds from now. A reservation must start and end on the same day, so do not record within a few seconds of midnight Bangkok time.
